! Game text
| Once during your deploy phase, may place 1 card from hand face down under Hem. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each card under Hem. {{Errata hl|1=If Hem lost or missing, place}} cards underneath him in Used Pile. During your control phase, may place all cards underneath Hem in Used Pile. || During your deploy phase, may stack ‘salt’ (a card from hand) face down under Hem. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each ‘salt’ card. During your control phase {{Errata hl|1=(or if Hem lost), may place}} all ‘salt’ cards in your Used Pile.
